propositions: Outbound create mutations must resolve the target project per ticket rather than using a single construction-time project value for both Cloud and Data Center transports
A ticket whose bridge_project resolves to a project absent from the mapping set must emit no create mutation to prevent creation against unsynced projects

The cross-project guard must relax from single-project equality to set membership check, permitting updates/deletes to any project in the configured mapping while remaining fail-closed for out-of-set targets

The reserved _bridge_target_project key must be stamped onto create mutations in outbound_differ and read by both transports, with Data Center explicitly dropping it before sending to Jira to prevent field validation errors
Single-project behavior must be preserved when no mapping is configured by falling back to the construction-time project value
